title: A Lidar Scan to Points: Ranges Become Points in the Sensor's Frame and Then in the Vehicle's, and What the Gaps Between Them Hide

artifact.note: a lidar scan as angles and ranges, its points in the sensor's frame (dropping every beam that returned nothing, was too near or too far) and in another frame through a transform, the spacing of the points at a range, the narrowest thing that two beams hit at a range, and the farthest range at which a thing of a width is still hit twice
